text:
mug_sam: Previous notes suggested kitchen_table_k1 for morning queries. Day 14 feedback at 07:48 confirmed kitchen_table_k1, but at 09:48 it was at coffee_table_l1. The mug moves to the living room earlier than expected (by late morning). Do not assume it stays in the kitchen until evening. Check coffee_table_l1 for queries after 09:00, and kitchen_table_k1 only for very early morning (before 08:00).

book_sam: Previous notes indicated armchair_l1 for evening reading. Day 14 feedback at 08:55 showed coffee_table_l1 in the morning. The book is frequently in the living room, specifically on the coffee table, rather than the bedroom or armchair. Check coffee_table_l1 as the primary candidate for daytime and evening queries. Avoid nightstand_b1 and bed_b1 unless there is specific recent evidence of movement to the bedroom.

charger_sam: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late evening. Day 14 feedback at 10:24 showed coffee_table_l1 in the morning, and at 22:39 confirmed nightstand_b1 in the late evening. The charger follows a clear pattern: it is in the living room (coffee_table_l1) during the day and moves to the bedroom (nightstand_b1) for the night. Check coffee_table_l1 for queries before 20:00 and nightstand_b1 for queries after 20:00. Do not check desk_b1.

glass_sam: No new feedback today. Previous erratic pattern (dining_table_d1, sink_k1, nightstand_b1) remains the best guide. Continue checking these three spots as equally likely candidates for evening queries. Do not default to a single location.

General Observation: Mug_sam and charger_sam have clearer time-based patterns than previously thought. Mug moves to living room by late morning; charger moves to bedroom by late evening. Book_sam is consistently in the living room (coffee_table_l1). Glass_sam remains unpredictable.
